rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken term for a teacher or educator.

example.english: The educator taught us how to learn wholeheartedly.
example.traditional: 老師教咗我哋點樣用心學習。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 gaau3 zo2 ngo5 dei6 dim2 joeng6 jung6 sam1 hok6 zaap6

rows.note: Use this for someone professionally engaged in education when they are not being identified specifically as a classroom teacher.

example.english: They are an educator who specializes in promoting education in the community.
example.traditional: 佢係一位教育工作者，專門推動社區教育。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 gaau3 juk6 gung1 zok3 ze2 zyun1 mun4 teoi1 dung6 se5 keoi1 gaau3 juk6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing a distinguished or influential figure in educational work rather than an ordinary teacher.

example.english: Dewey was an educator with far-reaching influence.
example.traditional: 杜威係一位影響深遠嘅教育家。
example.jyutping: dou6 wai1 hai6 jat1 wai2 jing2 hoeng2 sam1 jyun5 ge3 gaau3 juk6 gaa1
